messages.reason: Fund rewards pool for quest system payouts

title: Mint 100M MIRAGE to Rewards Pool
summary: Mint 100,000,000 MIRAGE to the rewards pool address (mirage1rwtz2m5wacl078c9d9rlss37046jxyr26wgftf) to fund quest system payouts. The rewards pool distributes MIRAGE to users who complete daily quests, flash quests, and achievements.
